build_Tao_dataset_builder: build a Tao dataset builder with configurable image resolution using TaoConfig
build_annotations_index: build annotation lookup dictionaries from TAO annotations for videos, images, tracks, and annotations
create_per_track_annotation: create per-track bounding box annotations with normalized coordinates and frame indices from TAO tracks
preprocess_annotations: preprocess TAO annotations by remapping category IDs, filtering negative IDs, and zero-indexing frame numbers
get_category_id_map: get a mapping from TAO category IDs to TFDS category indices filtered across train and validation sets
